purpose: DEBUG-only native navigation to existing Ask/Note/Idle pages. No UI changes.
patch:
diff --git a/tessera/Tessera/SettingsSheet.swift b/tessera/Tessera/SettingsSheet.swift
index 30390d3..63aa766 100644
--- a/tessera/Tessera/SettingsSheet.swift
+++ b/tessera/Tessera/SettingsSheet.swift
@@ -98,6 +98,9 @@ struct SettingsSheet: View {
             #if DEBUG
             .navigationDestination(isPresented: $qaRoutineOpen) {
                 switch qaRoutine {
+                case "ask": AskPage(accent: accent)
+                case "note": NotePage(accent: accent)
+                case "idle": idlePage
                 case "sun": SunPage(accent: accent)
                 case "sleep": SleepPage(accent: accent)
                 case "wake": WakePage(accent: accent)
